text:
One of those instants one lives

not knowing in what world, or in what time,

when the soul is not felt and barely

the existence of our body is felt,

my heart heard itself being called

from the misty threshold of some dream.


To tell me its strange message,

that voice was coming from so far away

that more than a dream voice it seemed,

in its gray mystery, the shadow of an echo.


I was sitting at that instant

in a soft velvet armchair.

My arms rested on its arms

-how faint I felt them afterward!-

Then, crossing the glass panes

of a great balcony that faced the wide sky,

I saw a shadow enter. Perhaps the afternoon,

as it left, was coming in to see me... I believe so...

translation.title: One of Those Instants One Lives
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the suspended dream-threshold and the afternoon entering like a shadow.
